# C++ library interface (`libfusion_core`) {#sec-api}

This reference documents the C++ classes, structs, namespaces, and functions provided by `libfusion_core`. The library is compiled with C++17 and relies on GDAL and LASlib/LASzip for robust geospatial point cloud and raster I/O.

---

## Point Cloud I/O (`fusion::lidar`)

Header: `#include "fusion/lidar/LASPointCloud.h"`

### `fusion::lidar::PointRecord`
Represents a single 3D point record extracted from a `.las` or `.laz` file.

```cpp
struct PointRecord {
    double x{0.0};
    double y{0.0};
    double z{0.0};
    uint16_t intensity{0};
    uint8_t returnNumber{1};
    uint8_t numberOfReturns{1};
    uint8_t classification{0};
    int16_t scanAngle{0};
    uint16_t pointSourceID{0};
    double gpsTime{0.0};
    uint16_t red{0};
    uint16_t green{0};
    uint16_t blue{0};
    uint16_t nir{0};
    bool withheld{false};
    bool keypoint{false};
    bool synthetic{false};
    bool overlap{false};
    uint8_t scannerChannel{0};
};
```

#### Fields
- `x`, `y`, `z` (`double`): Georeferenced spatial coordinates (in project units, e.g., meters or feet).
- `intensity` (`uint16_t`): Pulse return intensity (0–65535).
- `returnNumber` (`uint8_t`): Return number of the pulse (1-indexed).
- `numberOfReturns` (`uint8_t`): Total number of returns generated by the laser pulse.
- `classification` (`uint8_t`): ASPRS classification code (e.g., 2 = Ground, 3 = Low Veg, 4 = Medium Veg, 5 = High Veg).
- `scanAngle` (`int16_t`): Scan angle rank (-90 to +90 degrees).
- `pointSourceID` (`uint16_t`): Flight line or sensor source identifier.
- `gpsTime` (`double`): Adjusted GPS timestamp or time of day.
- `red`, `green`, `blue`, `nir` (`uint16_t`): Multispectral/RGB channel values.
- `withheld`, `keypoint`, `synthetic`, `overlap` (`bool`): ASPRS point classification flags.
- `scannerChannel` (`uint8_t`): Laser channel ID (for multi-channel lidar systems).

### `fusion::lidar::LASHeaderInfo`
Metadata header structure describing an open `.las` or `.laz` dataset.

```cpp
struct LASHeaderInfo {
    uint64_t pointCount{0};
    double minX{0.0}, maxX{0.0};
    double minY{0.0}, maxY{0.0};
    double minZ{0.0}, maxZ{0.0};
    double xScaleFactor{0.001}, yScaleFactor{0.001}, zScaleFactor{0.001};
    double xOffset{0.0}, yOffset{0.0}, zOffset{0.0};
    uint8_t pointFormat{0};
    uint8_t versionMajor{1}, versionMinor{2};
    bool isCompressed{false};
    std::string systemID;
    std::string generatingSoftware;
};
```

---

### `fusion::lidar::LASReader`
Sequential reader class for reading `.las` and `.laz` point cloud files.

#### Methods
- `bool Open(const std::filesystem::path& filePath)`
  - **Parameters**: `filePath` - Absolute or relative path to the `.las` or `.laz` file.
  - **Returns**: `true` if file opened successfully; `false` on file missing or corrupt header.
- `void Close()`
  - Closes the active file handle and frees internal reader memory.
- `bool IsOpen() const`
  - Returns `true` if a file is currently loaded and ready for reading.
- `const LASHeaderInfo& GetHeader() const`
  - Returns a reference to the parsed header metadata structure.
- `uint64_t GetPointCount() const`
  - Convenience method returning total point count in the dataset.
- `bool ReadNextPoint(PointRecord& pt)`
  - **Parameters**: `pt` - Output record populated with the next point attributes.
  - **Returns**: `true` if point was successfully read; `false` on reaching end of file (EOF).
- `void Rewind()`
  - Resets the reader stream cursor back to the first point.

---

### `fusion::lidar::LASWriter`
Writer class for exporting modified or generated point clouds to `.las` or `.laz` files.

#### Methods
- `bool Open(const std::filesystem::path& filePath, const LASHeaderInfo& header)`
  - **Parameters**: `filePath` - Target output path. `header` - Metadata header defining point format and scale factors.
  - **Returns**: `true` if output file created successfully.
- `bool WritePoint(const PointRecord& pt)`
  - **Parameters**: `pt` - Point record to append to dataset.
  - **Returns**: `true` on success.
- `void Close()`
  - Flushes output stream buffers and updates point count metadata in file header.

## Raster I/O & GDAL Engine (`fusion::raster`)

Header: `#include "fusion/raster/GDALRaster.h"`

### Enums & Data Structures

```cpp
enum class SampleMethod { Nearest, Bilinear };
enum class OutputMode { SingleBand, MultiBand };

struct RasterInfo {
    int width{0};
    int height{0};
    int numBands{0};
    double originX{0.0};
    double originY{0.0};
    double pixelWidth{1.0};
    double pixelHeight{1.0};
    double minX{0.0}, maxX{0.0};
    double minY{0.0}, maxY{0.0};
    double noDataValue{-9999.0};
    bool hasNoData{false};
    std::string projectionWKT;
};
```

---

### `fusion::raster::GDALRaster`
Wrapper around GDAL datasets supporting single-band ground DEMs and multi-band canopy metric GeoTIFF rasters.

#### Methods
- `bool Open(const std::filesystem::path& filePath, bool readWrite = false)`
  - Opens existing raster file (GeoTIFF, ERDAS Imagine, AAIGrid, etc.).
- `bool Create(const std::filesystem::path& filePath, int width, int height, int numBands = 1, const std::string& dataType = "Float32", const std::string& driverName = "GTiff", const std::string& projectionWKT = "", const double* geotransform = nullptr, double noDataValue = -9999.0)`
  - Creates a new GDAL raster dataset with specified resolution, bands, driver, and coordinate system.
- `std::optional<double> GetElevation(double x, double y, SampleMethod method = SampleMethod::Bilinear, int band = 1) const`
  - Samples continuous elevation or surface height at world coordinates $(x, y)$ using nearest-neighbor or bilinear interpolation.
- `std::optional<double> GetCellValue(int col, int row, int band = 1) const`
  - Reads specific cell value by 0-indexed column and row indices.
- `bool SetCellValue(int col, int row, double value, int band = 1)`
  - Writes cell value at column and row indices.
- `bool SetBandDescription(int band, const std::string& description)`
  - Sets descriptive string tag for a GDAL raster band (e.g. `"elev_p95"` or `"canopy_cover"`).
- `std::string GetBandDescription(int band) const`
  - Retrieves description string for band.
- `bool ReadBandData(int band, std::vector<float>& buffer) const`
  - Reads full raster band block into a contiguous float vector buffer (`width * height`).
- `bool WriteBandData(int band, const std::vector<float>& buffer)`
  - Writes float vector buffer to target band.
- `static bool BuildVRT(const std::filesystem::path& outputVRTPath, const std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& inputRasterPaths, bool relativePaths = true)`
  - Compiles multiple tile rasters into a unified Virtual Raster (`.vrt`) catalog.
- `static bool MergeVRTToGeoTIFF(const std::filesystem::path& vrtPath, const std::filesystem::path& outputGeoTIFFPath, const std::string& compressOption = "LZW")`
  - Merges tiles referenced in a VRT into a single GeoTIFF file with optional LZW compression.

## Parallel Batch Engine (`fusion::batch`)

Header: `#include "fusion/batch/BatchPipeline.h"`

### Data Structures

```cpp
struct TileGridSpec {
    double minX{0.0}, maxX{0.0};
    double minY{0.0}, maxY{0.0};
    double tileSizeX{1000.0};
    double tileSizeY{1000.0};
    double bufferDistance{50.0};
    double resolution{1.0};
};

struct TileInfo {
    int tileID{0};
    std::string name;
    double minX{0.0}, maxX{0.0};
    double minY{0.0}, maxY{0.0};
    double bufferedMinX{0.0}, bufferedMaxX{0.0};
    double bufferedMinY{0.0}, bufferedMaxY{0.0};
};
```

---

### `fusion::batch::BatchPipeline`
Engine for distributing tiled processing across multi-core CPUs.

#### Constructors & Methods
- `BatchPipeline(TileGridSpec gridSpec, PipelineJobOptions jobOptions)`
  - Initializes pipeline with spatial bounding extents and job options (thread counts, buffer overlaps, output paths).
- `bool ExecutePipeline(const std::function<bool(const TileInfo& tile, const PipelineJobOptions& opts)>& tileTask)`
  - Dispatches parallel execution across threads. Returns `true` if all tile tasks succeed.
- `const std::vector<std::filesystem::path>& GetGeneratedTileRasters() const`
  - Returns list of generated tile raster paths.
- `std::filesystem::path GetVRTPath() const`
  - Returns generated VRT catalog path.

---

## Status Logging (`fusion::batch`)

Header: `#include "fusion/batch/StatusMessenger.h"`

### `fusion::batch::StatusMessenger`
Thread-safe singleton logger for writing status updates to console stdout and optional log files.

#### Methods
- `static StatusMessenger& Instance()` - Retrieves singleton instance.
- `void SetLogFile(const std::filesystem::path& logPath)` - Sets optional destination file path.
- `void SendStatus(const std::string& statusMessage, bool quiet = false)` - Logs string message.
- `void SendProgress(const std::string& jobName, int current, int total)` - Formats and logs percentage progress string (e.g., `Job Progress: 5/10 (50%)`).

## Experimental Lidar Metrics (`fusion::metrics`)

Header: `#include "fusion/metrics/ExperimentalMetrics.h"`

### Data Structures

```cpp
struct Point3D {
    double x{0.0};
    double y{0.0};
    double z{0.0};
};

struct ExperimentalMetricsOptions {
    double minHt{2.0};        // Minimum canopy height cutoff
    double cellSize{10.0};     // 2D grid cell resolution (input units)
    double voxelSize{20.0};    // 3D voxel resolution (input units)
};
```

### Functions
- `ExperimentalMetricsResults ComputeExperimentalMetrics(const std::vector<Point3D>& points, const ExperimentalMetricsOptions& options)`
  - Calculates relative height metrics, 2D/3D radial distances, grid cell area/column volume, and 3D voxel occupancy volume for a point set.
- `std::map<std::string, double> GetExperimentalMetricsAsMap(const ExperimentalMetricsResults& res)`
  - Converts result struct into string key-value map for CSV export.
- `std::vector<std::string> GetExperimentalMetricsNames()`
  - Returns ordered list of metric column names.

## CLI Argument Parsing (`fusion::cli`)

Header: `#include "fusion/cli/ArgumentParser.h"`

### `fusion::cli::ArgumentParser`
Case-insensitive parser for command-line options and flags supporting Windows slash (`/option:val`), single dash (`-option val`), and double dash (`--option=val`) syntaxes.

#### Methods
- `ArgumentParser(std::string programName, std::string description)`
- `void AddFlag(const std::string& name, const std::string& description)`
- `void AddOption(const std::string& name, const std::string& description, const std::string& defaultValue = "")`
- `bool Parse(int argc, char* argv[])`
- `bool HasFlag(const std::string& name) const`
- `std::optional<std::string> GetOption(const std::string& name) const`
- `const std::vector<std::string>& GetPositionalArgs() const`
- `void PrintHelp() const`
